-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/lockinplace

go 1.27
-- probe/inplace/inplace.go --
package inplace

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		s.Items = append(s.Items, "a")
		s.Items[0] = "b"
	})
}
-- probe/scalarread/scalarread.go --
package scalarread

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

func Use() int {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	var n, m int
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		n = len(s.Items)
		m = cap(s.Items)
	})
	return n + m
}
-- probe/nilcheck/nilcheck.go --
package nilcheck

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

func Use() bool {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	var ok bool
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		ok = s.Items != nil
	})
	return ok
}
-- probe/escape/escape.go --
package escape

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

var outer []string

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		outer = s.Items
	})
}
-- probe/outerindex/outerindex.go --
package outerindex

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

var outer [4][]string

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		outer[0] = s.Items
	})
}
-- probe/holderstore/holderstore.go --
package holderstore

import "logos/sync"

type Holder struct{ Leaked any }

type State struct {
	Items  []string
	Target *Holder
}

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		s.Target.Leaked = s.Items
	})
}
-- probe/storedfn/storedfn.go --
package storedfn

import "logos/sync"

type State struct{ Items []string }

var fn func() int

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		fn = func() int { return len(s.Items) }
	})
}
-- probe/addrof/addrof.go --
package addrof

import "logos/sync"

type Inner struct{ Items []string }

type State struct{ Inner Inner }

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		(&s.Inner).Items = s.Inner.Items[:1]
	})
}
-- probe/parenread/parenread.go --
package parenread

import "logos/sync"

type State struct{ Items []string }

func Use() int {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	var n int
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		n = len((s.Items))
	})
	return n
}
